title: 24 Hours to Kill Kuldra From Scratch | RuneScape: Dragonwilds
author: SuperStooob
description:
Can I kill Kuldra in RuneScape: Dragonwilds within 24 hours, starting completely from scratch?

A fresh character, a fresh world, and a 24-hour countdown. I’ll be gathering resources, building, crafting gear and fighting my way towards Kuldra—with every death counted on screen.

Join me live on Saturday 17 October. Bring your predictions, questionable advice and moral support. How many deaths will it take?

This challenge continues across multiple YouTube broadcasts so the full run can be archived. The challenge timer carries on between parts.

Subscribe for more RuneScape: Dragonwilds guides, challenges and boss fights.

Music provided by NoCopyrightSounds.
